headline: VERTICES PARTNERS acts on Karta AI seed fundraise
sum: Dreamzest Technologies Private Limited, dba Karta AI, has raised ₹28.52 crore [USD 3 million] from a seed fundraise led by Peer Capital and Cedar Hill Capital, with participation from other Wyser VC, CDM Capital and Seedstars. VERTICES…
detail: Dreamzest Technologies Private Limited, dba Karta AI, has raised ₹28.52 crore [USD 3 million] from a seed fundraise led by Peer Capital and Cedar Hill Capital, with participation from other Wyser VC, CDM Capital and Seedstars. VERTICES PARTNERS advised Karta AI on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Manu Varghese (Partner) along with a team that included Hemant Srivastava (Associate Manager), Associates Abhishikha Moyal and Priyanshi Bainwala. Manu Varghese Marga Law represented Capier Investments India on this fundraise.
